title: Listen to Ron Bennington’s "PORTCAST" Comedy Podcast
summary: Shane Gillis, Michael Che, Tim Dillon, Jim Norton, Colin Quinn, Stavros Halkias, David Cross, and more.
body_markdown:
Legendary broadcaster and comedian Ron Bennington is turning his chemotherapy treatments into a new kind of comedy podcast.


*PORTCAST* is recorded from Bennington’s chemotherapy chair as friends including Shane Gillis, Michael Che, Tim Dillon, Jim Norton, Sal Vulcano, Joe List, Gary Gulman, Matteo Lane, Dan Soder, Colin Quinn, Stavros Halkias, and Dave Attell sit beside him for candid — and often very funny — conversations about cancer, comedy, friendship, life and death. Additional guests will join Bennington during future treatment cycles.


The podcast’s name comes from the surgically implanted port used to administer Bennington’s treatment.


Starting September 15 at 10am ET, check out *PORTCAST* episodes on YouTube, the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogAppHome) , and wherever you get your podcasts.


Bennington continues to host[The Bennington Show](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/bennington-show) on SiriusXM’s[Faction Talk](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/faction-talk) alongside his daughter, Gail Bennington, who has also taken a leading role on her father’s care team.


[Fans and friends can also leave messages for Bennington on SiriusXM’s Bennington Mosaic Wall](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/ron-bennington) , which has received messages from comedians including Bill Burr, Wanda Sykes, Shane Gillis, Bert Kreischer, Jim Norton, Colin Quinn, Dan Soder, and Tim Dillon.
